name: ns_eviction_discriminator
description: Bounded ZTARE substrate for discovering compact local observables that separate Navier-Stokes stretching consolidation from anti-blowup eviction/sterility.

cage_meta.class_reason: This is a finite proof-path discriminator over audited diagnostic rows. It has no numeric farther-tail coordinate; the output must name a fresh falsifying experiment rather than claim extrapolation.

farther_tail_region_disable_reason: No numeric farther-tail region exists for this proof-path/audit substrate. Generalization is tested by the required Generative Yield dimension and future Kida-Pelz diagnostics, not by a coordinate-range extrapolation gate.
persona: You are an adversarial PDE proof-path auditor. Your task is to propose a compact, falsifiable scalar law I_model(features)->sterility_next that predicts whether a local Navier-Stokes peak state proceeds toward stretching consolidation or anti-blowup eviction/sterility. You must not claim global regularity or a Clay solution. You must name the next experiment that would falsify your discriminator.

dimensions.name: Observable Compression
dimensions.description: Does the thesis propose a compact mathematical discriminator using local geometry features such as a_pos, chi, strain_projection, lambda_positive, support_leakage, and omega_max, rather than lookup tables by source phase or family?

dimensions.name: Holdout Validation
dimensions.description: Does test_model.py pass the deterministic holdout gate in gate_harness.py with MAE < 0.20 and max/critical-row error < 0.30?

dimensions.name: Proof-Path Usefulness
dimensions.description: Does the thesis translate the discriminator into a concrete next proof-path decision: universal eviction law, Kida-Pelz inverse construction, second eviction channel, or abandoned branch?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the thesis make at least two concrete, falsifiable predictions for fresh diagnostics, such as Kida-Pelz N=128/N=256 or another symmetry-locked flow?

dimensions.name: Rival Falsification
dimensions.description: Does the thesis compare against at least two rival discriminators, such as chi-only, a_pos-only, strain_projection-only, and support_leakage-only?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the thesis explicitly avoid overclaiming global Navier-Stokes regularity from this finite substrate?

criteria.Observable_Compression: Full credit requires a formula or algorithm that could be tested on a fresh Kida-Pelz N>=128 run. Penalize use of family/source_phase as direct lookup keys.
criteria.Holdout_Validation: gate_harness.py is authoritative. The thesis must cite the JSON output. Averaging away the critical hidden danger-exit row does not pass.
criteria.Proof_Path_Usefulness: A useful result names what experiment should run next and what result would kill the proposed observable.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires two numeric, falsifiable predictions for future diagnostic rows. Qualitative next-step prose is not enough.
criteria.Rival_Falsification: At least two simpler rivals must be evaluated on the same visible/holdout split.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject Clay-solution claims. This substrate is an instrument for mechanism discovery.
